placements.title: Ingestion Pipeline Guarantees Identification via Dynamic Generation and Deterministic Fallback
placements.frame: How does the ingestion pipeline resolve document identity and ensure persistence when incoming submissions omit an explicit identifier?
placements.why: The segments assert that memory submissions lacking an explicit id must be assigned an identity through a fallback-safe pipeline flow (LLM slug generation or deterministic slugify) and committed cleanly to storage.
